beats.event: Alphonso beats and rapes teenage Celie; she writes to God
Alphonso gives her to Mister instead of her sister Nettie
Beaten by Mister; abused by his prior children
Nettie runs to her; is driven off by Mister
Nettie's letters never come; concludes she is dead
Watches Sofia's fierce self-esteem with awe
Mister's mistress Shug arrives ill; Celie nurses her
She and Shug become friends despite Shug's rudeness
Shug helps her love her own body
They find Nettie's letters hidden by Mister for years
Learns Nettie is alive, a missionary in Africa
Learns Alphonso was only her stepfather
Curses Mister and leaves with Shug for Memphis
Alphonso dies; she inherits the family land
Crushed when Shug falls in love with Germaine
Content on her own; Shug returns, having ended it
Reunited with Nettie, Samuel, and her children after 30 years
